name: Compound Knowledge
description: AI-powered workflows for knowledge work: brainstorm, plan, review, execute, and save learnings. Knowledge compounds.

conversation_starters.title: Brainstorm
conversation_starters.text: Brainstorm: I need to think through our Q2 content strategy. Here's what I know so far...

conversation_starters.title: Plan
conversation_starters.text: Plan: Structure a campaign plan for the upcoming product launch

conversation_starters.title: Confidence check
conversation_starters.text: Confidence: How confident are we in the current approach? What gaps exist?

conversation_starters.title: Review
conversation_starters.text: Review: Check this plan for strategic alignment and data accuracy before I share it

conversation_starters.title: Execute
conversation_starters.text: Work: Execute the plan and produce the deliverables

conversation_starters.title: Save learnings
conversation_starters.text: Compound: Extract and save what we learned from this session
